title: A Phase 2 trial of AGMB-447 in participants with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis
official: A Phase 2, Double-blind, Randomized, Placebo-controlled, Multicenter Trial to Assess the Efficacy, Safety, and Tolerability of AGMB-447 in Participants with Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the effect of AGMB-447 on lung function in participants with IPF, compared to placebo.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Participant aged ≥40 years at the time of signing the ICF.
2. Diagnosis of IPF within 7 years prior to the screening visit, confirmed by centrally reviewed HRCT of the chest
3. Confirmed pulmonary function criteria at screening, as follows: a.	FVC ≥45% predicted of normal, as determined by spirometry,  b.	FEV1/FVC >0.7 or lower limit or normal, as determined by spirometry, c. DLCO corrected for hemoglobin ≥25% predicted of normal.
4. On standard of care for the treatment of IPF, at a stable dose for at least 8 weeks before the screening visit, and during the screening period; or not on antifibrotic treatment and stable for at least 4 weeks before the screening visit (naïve or intolerant).
5. Women of non childbearing potential or male participants willing to comply with this protocol's requirements regarding contraception.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Diagnosis of fibrosing interstitial lung disease (ILD) other than IPF.
2. Acute IPF exacerbation within 6 months prior to screening and/or during the screening period.
3. Lower respiratory tract infection requiring treatment within 4 weeks prior to screening and/or during the screening period.
4. History of lung volume reduction surgery or lung transplant or major surgery performed within 3 months prior to baseline or planned during the trial (being on a transplant list is allowed)
5. Systemic or opportunistic infections including:  a.	Active infection with human immunodeficiency virus.  b.	Known current tuberculosis infection.  c.	Positive for hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) or hepatitis B core antibody (HBcAb).   d. Chronic HCV (positive hepatitis C virus antibody [HCVAb] and hepatitis C virus [HCV] RNA).
6. Concurrent or previous participation in another clinical trial and received investigational therapy within 4 weeks or 5 half-lives (whichever is longer) prior to screening.
